div.div: Use `max_iter` parameter for longitudinal template generation.

I think we want to add something like pipeline_setup: # options: human, non-human primate, rodent (1 more line was trimmed) to the pipeline configuration and update https://github.com/FCP-INDI/C-PAC/blob/61ad414447023daf0e401a81c92267b09c64ed94/CPAC/registration/registration.py#L2309-L2314 to if cfg.pipeline_setup["organism"] != ["non-human primate"]: , but I'm unsure:
if organism is the key we want, if human, non-human primate, rodent is the controlled vocabulary we want or if we want to also differentiate between children and adults (in humans and/or in other organisms), and/or differentiate nhps and rodents more specifically than that, or
if we really need this information or if there's a simpler approach or refactor of the config to achieve the same clarity, or what other places we want to use this option for a conditional instead of whatever's already there.
Also, the pipeline validation schema can be updated to make these https://github.com/FCP-INDI/C-PAC/blob/61ad414447023daf0e401a81c92267b09c64ed94/CPAC/pipeline/schema.py#L710-L711 required for nhp pipelines (and these https://github.com/FCP-INDI/C-PAC/blob/61ad414447023daf0e401a81c92267b09c64ed94/CPAC/pipeline/schema.py#L694-L695 might be optional for nhp pipelines? Or maybe all we need to do is get rid of the FNIRT_T1w* keys altogether and do registration_workflows: anatomical_registration: (2 more lines were trimmed) in the nhp pipelines?)
